caption: A cinema's house lights dim before the film starts, and the seats fade from view until only the screen glows.

sa.check: A cinema's house lights are on.
The dimming comes first and the seats fade with it.

pc.expect: The dimming is gradual and the seats go dark until only the screen glows.
pc.fail: The lights snap off; or brighten again; or the seats stay visible with the lights out.

pc.expect: The screen's light on the front rows changes with the picture.
pc.fail: The front rows are lit with the screen dark; or stay dark with a bright screen; or are lit from behind.
Seats move; or the screen shifts; or the lit area wanders.
The seats change colour; or the walls change; or the light turns another colour.
Seats vanish; or appear; or the screen duplicates.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.
The rows rearrange; or the screen changes size; or the curtains change.

note: Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
